practice_with_photographs_narrow_your_fo: Practice with photographs, narrow your focus to a bird family, and return to the species that need another look.
listen_to_macaulay_library_recordings_wi: Listen to Macaulay Library recordings, with the closest available geographic matches and clear notes on their limits.
choose_stops_and_visit_dates_then_previe: Choose stops and visit dates, then preview the birds and share a trip your AviQuiz friends can try.
include_species_reported_in_only_one_sea: Include species reported in only one season
includes_rarities_and_one_time_sightings: Includes rarities and one-time sightings, as well as birds that may be regular but were recorded in only one sampled season.
add_a_bird_to_the_trip_s_quiz_as_a_study: Add a bird to the trip’s quiz as a study target, with no stop association or reporting rate. The prototype offers only a small set of common birds.
anyone_with_the_link_who_can_access_aviq: Anyone with the link who can access AviQuiz can open it. The link contains the itinerary and can be forwarded. Editing creates a new link; an old link cannot be revoked here.
the_preview_uses_fixed_seasonal_windows_: The preview uses fixed seasonal windows from eBird’s September 2026 Basic Dataset. Earlier stops use 2017–2025 checklists; the April stops and Brazil hotspots also include records through 2026 for their respective study months. Recurring means reported in at least two sampled seasons. Date changes within a window use the same list. A stop marked “Trip report only” uses species reported on that trip’s checklists and is included regardless of the one-season setting.
one_question_per_species_with_a_photo_pr: One question per species with a photo. Prototype quizzes don’t change saved statistics.
checklist_data_cornell_lab_of_ornitholog: Checklist data: Cornell Lab of Ornithology, eBird Basic Dataset, EBD_relSep-2026. Photo credit appears in the quiz.
pick_a_site_focus_on_a_family_or_follow_: Pick a site, focus on a family, or follow your curiosity across the whole checklist.
visual_and_audio_accuracy_and_mistake_re: Visual and audio accuracy and mistake review are tracked separately.
review_birds_missed_more_than_25_of_the_: Review birds missed more than 25% of the time over their last 20 answered photos (or all attempts if fewer). Correct answers can remove birds from review. Revealed answers count as misses; unavailable photos do not count.
sets_questions_to_the_current_scope_s_pl: Sets Questions to the current scope’s playable species count, with one question per species, including when a family is selected. Updates as filters change. Species without media in the selected mode are excluded. Uncheck to enter a custom count.
checking_show_all_families_lets_you_see_: Checking “Show all families” lets you see families that are not represented in the current species list. Selecting one of those families will produce no eligible species for this scope.
choose_a_family_to_practice_different_ph: Choose a family to practice different photos of the same species. Site and lifer filters still apply.
experimental_tips_and_arrow_placements_m: Experimental: tips and arrow placements may be imperfect. This feature may change or be removed at any time. Off by default. While enabled, all answers in the quiz are excluded from statistics and recent mistake history; your session results remain available.
approved_photos_have_checked_arrows_othe: Approved photos have checked arrows; other photos of covered species have general text tips. Guidance is paraphrased from eBird / Merlin (Cornell Lab of Ornithology), with a link to the source. Tips appear only after a wrong or revealed answer.
annotation_review_uses_only_published_an: Annotation review uses only published annotated photos you have not marked reviewed in this browser. It shows the species and annotations directly, uses your site, family and question count, ignores lifer filters, and never changes learning statistics. Audio is unavailable in this mode.
mark_the_original_26_photos_already_revi: Mark the original 26 photos already reviewed
personal_annotation_review_marks_are_sep: Personal annotation-review marks are separate from shared approval and saved only in this browser. Earlier views were not tracked; use the button above if you have reviewed the original batch.
visual_and_audio_progress_are_saved_sepa: Visual and audio progress are saved separately in this browser. Other browsers and devices have separate histories.
start_with_20_questions_or_set_your_own_: Start with 20 questions, or set your own pace. Choose photographs or vocalizations, and come back to the birds you miss.
lifer_filters_use_the_original_ebird_exp: Lifer filters use the original eBird export from October 7, 2026.
site_quizzes_include_only_species_marked: Site quizzes include only species marked X in that site’s column. “Entire trip checklist” includes every species, including species without an X at any site. Lifer filters compare with your eBird export as of October 7, 2026. Colombia lifers include worldwide lifers. These are potential lifers based on your exported records, rather than the spreadsheet’s bold and italic formatting.
scientific_names_were_reconciled_for_13_: Scientific names were reconciled for 13 checklist spelling errors. The original spreadsheet is unchanged. Photos are sourced exclusively from the Macaulay Library and credited to their contributors. Internet access is needed to load them. With All families selected, question sets contain distinct species. “Use all eligible species” sets the question count automatically for the current filters and selected medium, and includes each playable species once even with a family selected. Annotation review instead includes all eligible unreviewed photos. When you select a specific family, species may repeat with different photos; each photo is used at most once per quiz. If you request more questions than the available species or photos, the quiz uses the entire available pool.
regular_and_review_answers_contribute_by: Regular and review answers contribute by species and medium, except when experimental ID tips are enabled. Account history and browser statistics have separate storage controls. Experimental sessions do not change statistics or recent mistake history, even for species without tips. Recent review uses each species’ last 20 attempts in the selected medium and includes it only when more than 25% were missed. Review quizzes ignore lifer filters and show each eligible species once, using available media in that medium. The end-of-quiz review includes every species missed in that quiz, even when its overall miss rate is 25% or less. Start over resets quiz settings, while keeping your learning history.
audio_questions_use_macaulay_library_voc: Audio questions use Macaulay Library vocalizations. We prefer a recording from the named site area, then the same department, then Colombia, then a broader fallback. This preference searches only our current catalog. A department may span different slopes, habitats, and elevations. We have not verified site subspecies assignments or subspecies matches; proximity alone is not proof of a match. The exact, regional, or fallback basis, contributor, source link, location, sound type when known, and subspecies limitations are shown after answering.
all_sites_scope_spans_several_regions_th: All-sites scope spans several regions. The high- and mid-elevation Montezuma scopes currently share a general-area preference; recording elevation has not been matched. Bellavista’s precise location remains unresolved and uses country-level fallbacks. A recording may contain background species, calls rather than song, or only part of a species’ repertoire. Catalog identity and geographic metadata are verified, but every clip has not been auditioned for clarity. Species without verified recording records are excluded; the setup shows coverage. Recordings can become unavailable. Retry, or use the unscored skip for an unclear or unavailable recording.
press_play_before_submitting_an_audio_an: Press Play before submitting an audio answer; replaying does not create additional attempts. Identifying recording metadata is hidden until answering. Photo ID tips are for visual practice only. Visual and audio answers use separate histories, each retaining the last 20 scored attempts per species for accuracy calculations. Existing history remains visual. Review thresholds and statistics use only the selected medium.
a_little_more_familiar_every_time_e3aafd: A LITTLE MORE FAMILIAR, EVERY TIME
see_what_is_sticking_and_where_a_little_: See what is sticking, and where a little more practice might help.
full_historical_statistics_are_available: Full historical statistics are available only to signed-in users. Guest statistics cover up to five recent completed quizzes.
import_older_browser_statistics_into_my_: Import older browser statistics into my account
this_is_on_by_default_for_signed_in_acco: This is on by default for signed-in accounts. AviQuiz folds completed, eligible regular quizzes and mistake reviews into cumulative correct and attempted counts, with separate visual and audio statistics. It retains the latest comparison result for each scope and a small recent-mistake buffer. It does not retain a quiz archive. Experimental, annotation-review, trip, and geography quizzes continue to be excluded.
turning_it_off_stops_future_account_save: Turning it off stops future account saves. It does not delete existing account history. Quizzes taken while off are not uploaded later when you turn it back on. The browser can still keep five recent quizzes if you allowed that separately. Correct ID rates use all counted account practice, including the information available in an imported browser snapshot. Mistake review uses a bounded recent-attempt buffer, so old lifetime misses do not dominate review.
guest_quizzes_always_remain_available_ac: Guest quizzes always remain available. Account statistics follow your sign-in across devices; browser records belong to this device and origin. If synchronization fails, keep the tab open and retry. Only five quizzes can be retained across a reload.
this_adds_the_older_visual_and_audio_rol: This adds the older visual and audio rolling statistics and latest results to your currently signed-in account. It does not upload your guesses, media, or photo review marks. It cannot reconstruct quiz dates that were never stored.
one_legacy_snapshot_may_be_imported_per_: One legacy snapshot may be imported per account. Repeating the same import is safe; a different overlapping snapshot will be refused. After the server confirms import, the acknowledged old statistics are removed from this browser. Export a backup first if you want a separate copy.
correct_ids_scored_attempts_in_the_selec: Correct IDs ÷ scored attempts in the selected medium. Percentages use all counted account practice, or the rolling five-quiz aggregate for guests. — means no answers yet.
regular_quizzes_and_mistake_reviews_coun: Regular quizzes and mistake reviews count; sessions with experimental ID tips enabled do not. Each scored question counts once: correct IDs count as successes; wrong or revealed answers count as misses. Unscored skips and unavailable media do not count. Rates combine the answer counts, rather than averaging species percentages.
with_site_only_quizzes_switched_off_site: With Site-only quizzes switched off, site rates cover every species marked X for that site using its answers from any quiz, so a species can contribute to several sites. With it switched on, only answers from quizzes scoped to that exact site with All families selected count, including site-scoped mistake reviews. Scored correct and attempted counts are maintained independently for each site. Both views are tracked regardless of the display switch. Older answers without site context are included only in the all-scopes view. Family rates always cover all quiz scopes and sites. Visual and audio histories are separate; existing history belongs to visual practice. Your current quiz filters do not change these summaries. Account history is available when signed in; guest summaries use the five most recent completed quizzes if browser storage is allowed.
latest_quiz_shows_the_last_completed_reg: Latest quiz shows the last completed regular quiz or mistake review that selected this site or family. A quiz with both selected updates both rows. The Site-only switch shows the latest result with All families selected. Species shown counts unique species out of the playable pool when that quiz started, after its filters. Questions include skips, and accuracy uses only scored questions. Latest results are saved for quizzes completed from this update onward.
move_or_back_up_your_progress_4675d3b7: Move or back up your progress
export_your_visual_and_audio_history_sit: Export your visual and audio history, site-only statistics, latest comparison results, and personal photo review marks. To move to aviquiz.org, export here, then open Statistics on the new site and import the file.
import_replaces_this_browser_s_saved_his: Import replaces this browser’s saved history and review marks with the file’s contents. Export your current progress first if you want to keep it. Reimporting a file restores the same snapshot. Close other AviQuiz tabs while importing.
replace_saved_progress_with_this_file_2e: Replace saved progress with this file
correct_ids_scored_attempts_in_the_avail: Correct IDs ÷ scored attempts in the available aggregate history, across regular quizzes and reviews. Revealed answers count as misses; unavailable photos do not count. — means no answers yet.
the_recording_may_be_unavailable_or_slow: The recording may be unavailable or slow to load.
enter_the_common_or_scientific_name_hyph:
Enter the common or scientific name.
Hyphens, spaces, and small typos are okay.
one_randomly_selected_site_from_this_spe: One randomly selected site from this species’ checklist. Media locality may differ. Stays on between questions until switched off.
enlarged_photo_scroll_to_see_more_3d313d: Enlarged photo. Scroll to see more.
these_are_identification_pointers_not_a_: These are identification pointers, not a complete identification key. Tips and arrow placements may be imperfect. This feature may change or be removed at any time.
annotated_bird_photograph_scroll_horizon: Annotated bird photograph; scroll horizontally on small screens
on_a_small_screen_scroll_the_diagram_sid: On a small screen, scroll the diagram sideways to read the labels. Text boxes sit outside the photograph.
aviquiz_learn_the_birds_enjoy_the_field_: AviQuiz / Learn the birds. Enjoy the field.
photos_amp_recordings_contributors_to_co: Photos & recordings: contributors to Cornell Lab of Ornithology | Macaulay Library
keep_recent_practice_statistics_in_this_: Keep recent practice statistics in this browser?
with_your_permission_aviquiz_keeps_aggre: With your permission, AviQuiz keeps aggregate statistics covering your five most recent completed quizzes on this device. Small contribution totals keep that rolling window accurate and support retries if the connection fails; this is not a quiz archive. You can take quizzes without allowing browser statistics storage.
signed_in_account_history_is_a_separate_: Signed-in account history is a separate setting on the Statistics page. No advertising or tracking cookies are used for these statistics. We remember your storage choice even if you decline.
what_aviquiz_stores_in_your_browser_29c4: What AviQuiz stores in your browser
if_allowed_we_keep_species_level_correct: If allowed, we keep species-level correct and attempted counts for a rolling window of five quizzes across visual and audio practice, a bounded recent-mistake buffer, and the latest comparison results. Small contribution totals, scope, medium, and synchronization identifiers let us remove old contributions and avoid duplicate uploads. We do not keep a question-by-question quiz archive, your guesses, passwords, or media files.
we_retain_one_small_storage_choice_flag_: We retain one small storage-choice flag so we can honor your decision. Sign-in uses essential session storage. Personal photo review marks are stored separately by the review feature. Browser statistics permission does not control those records or account history.
older_statistics_already_present_in_this: Older statistics already present in this browser are preserved until you explicitly import them into your account. They contain rolling answers and latest results, not a complete dated quiz log. New quizzes do not grow that old snapshot. Export it before clearing browser data if you want an additional backup.
you_can_change_browser_statistics_permis: You can change browser statistics permission on the Statistics page. Declining removes the recent-quiz cache; existing unimported history is preserved to avoid accidental loss.
